title: Inventory
overview: This guide covers inventory workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Browse the inventory list
subtasks.purpose: Get an at-a-glance view of every product category, its price, on-hand quantity and status.

steps.title: Open Inventory List
steps.description: Click Inventory in the left sidebar.

steps.title: Search Inventory
steps.description: Use the Search box to filter by product name, category, or model number.

steps.title: Sort Inventory List
steps.description: Sort by clicking any column header (e.g. Received Date, Price, Qty).

steps.title: Page Through Inventory
steps.description: Use the pager (Page 1 of N, arrows) or change Show entries to page through the catalog.

steps.title: Audit Inventory Activity
steps.description: Click Event Logs (bottom) to audit inventory add / edit / delete activity. Notes The Status chip (A = Active) means the product is available for assignment; inactive products remain visible for historical reference but cannot be issued to patients. Qty represents the total number of individual devices tracked under this product; expand via the eye icon to see per-serial mappings.

subtasks.title: Add a new inventory item
subtasks.purpose: Register a new product category (BP monitor, glucose meter, scale, etc.) into the system.

steps.title: Add Inventory Item
steps.description: Click + Add Inventory (top-right).

steps.title: Fill Product Details
steps.description: Fill in Product Category, Product Name, Model Number, Received Date, Price and Qty of Each Category.

steps.title: Enter Gateway Serial
steps.description: Optionally enter a Gateway Serial Number for cellular hubs.

steps.title: Set Status Active
steps.description: Set Status = Active.

steps.title: Save Inventory Item
steps.description: Click OK to save, or Cancel to discard. Notes Qty determines how many serial numbers can be mapped later under Inventory Details.

subtasks.title: View inventory details & mapped devices (eye icon)
subtasks.purpose: Drill into a product to see every individual device serial and its assignment status.

steps.title: Open Inventory Details
steps.description: From the Inventory List, click the eye icon on the target product row.

steps.title: Review Inventory Header
steps.description: Review the Inventory Details header: Product Category, Product Name, Meter Model, Received Date, Price, Qty of Each Category, Status and Gateway Serial Number.

steps.title: Scroll to Mapped Devices
steps.description: Scroll to Mapped device to see the per-device roster (Product Name, Product Model Number, Product Serial Number, Assignee, Assigning Date).

steps.title: Search or Sort Devices
steps.description: Use the Search box or column sort to locate a specific serial.

steps.title: Add New Meter
steps.description: Click + Add new meter to register additional serial numbers under this product.

steps.title: Return to Inventory List
steps.description: Click List (top-right) to return to the Inventory List. Notes Rows where Assignee = N/A are unassigned devices available for issue; a name and Assigning Date mean the device is currently allocated to a patient. Serial numbers created under Add new meter count toward the product’s Qty of Each Category.

subtasks.title: Edit an inventory item (pencil icon)
subtasks.purpose: Update product-level data such as price, quantity, status or review the on-file serial numbers.

steps.title: Open Edit Inventory Modal
steps.description: Click the pencil icon on the target inventory row — the Edit Products modal opens.

steps.title: Update Inventory Fields
steps.description: Update Product Category, Qty of Each Category, Product Name, Received Date, Model Number, Gateway Serial Number, Price or Status as needed.

steps.title: Review Serial Numbers
steps.description: Review the Serial numbers on file list at the bottom of the modal (read-only).

steps.title: Save Inventory Changes
steps.description: Click OK to save changes or Cancel to discard. Notes Assigned serials cannot be changed from this screen — the modal shows the message "Assigned serials cannot be changed from this screen." Use Inventory Details → Mapped device to manage individual devices. Decreasing Qty below the number of already-mapped serials is blocked by validation. Setting Status = Inactive keeps historical records intact but prevents new assignments.

subtasks.title: Delete an inventory item (trash icon)
subtasks.purpose: Permanently remove a product from inventory.

steps.title: Delete Inventory Item
steps.description: Click the red trash icon on the target inventory row.

steps.title: Confirm Deletion
steps.description: Confirm the deletion in the modal. Notes If any mapped device is still assigned, the system blocks deletion — unassign devices first or mark the product Inactive instead. Task 6.5 — Billing Reports
